text: New updates and improvements to Runway. Latest updates Sep 8, 2026 Paid Plans Introducing Runway Plugins for Adobe Runway now runs in a panel inside Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. Generate images and video with Runway's full model lineup, restyle the footage already on your timeline with Aleph 2 and place every result directly into your comp or sequence, without leaving your edit. Free download for macOS and Windows, works with your existing paid plan and credits. Sep 4, 2026 All Plans Introducing Team Plan Team is a new self-serve plan for small teams that create together in Runway. Every seat adds 6,900 credits a month to one shared pool, and up to nine people work from shared projects in one workspace with 1TB of storage. Comment on generations, share agent skills and connect the Runway Agent to your tools. Aug 31, 2026 Paid Plans Runway Ruby in Tool Mode Ruby is now available as its own model in the Tool Mode model selector, with a dedicated UI. Bring in videos from outside Runway and color-grade them with Ruby. Aug 24, 2026 Enterprise Org Config Alerts Org admins now see alerts in org settings when workspaces are missing SSO enforcement or lack a low-credit email, with a link to fix each issue directly. Aug 24, 2026 Enterprise Default SSO for New Workspaces Org admins can now set a default SSO configuration that automatically applies to every new workspace created in the org. This removes the need to manually copy SSO settings each time a new workspace is spun up. Aug 24, 2026 Paid Plans Wan 3.0 Wan 3.0 is now available in Runway in tool mode and workflows. Generate near state-of-the-art video with audio, using multiple image, video, and audio reference inputs, at 480p, 720p, or 1080p. Aug 20, 2026 All Plans Workflow Support in Runway MCP Agents can now list workflows in your workspace, open one in the web app editor, tweak it, and run it from chat. Built for advanced, re-runnable pipelines you don't want to put together by hand. Aug 20, 2026 Pro+ Plans Runway Ruby Transform any SDR video into true HDR with Runway Ruby, a native color grading model available in Tool Mode, Workflows, and Runway Dev. Convert outputs from any model, first or third party, or your own existing video files, and get updated brightness and color range for professional-grade HDR results. Aug 19, 2026 Paid Plans Seedream 5.0 Pro Layers Split images into layers with a new tool that lets you toggle and transform each layer independently. Ideal for fine-grained image editing and asset extraction. Aug 18, 2026 All Plans Compositing Nodes Compose and blend images and video together with new compositing workflow nodes, now available to all customers. Aug 15, 2026 Paid Plans SD2.5 1080p Seedance 2.5 now generates in 1080p across all surfaces. Get sharper, higher-resolution results wherever you create. Aug 13, 2026 Paid Plans Ideogram 4.0 Ideogram's latest image model is now available in Runway MCP as ideogram-4, for text-to-image or remixing from a single reference. It excels at accurate, readable text in designs, with support for ultra-tall 9:21 and ultra-wide 21:9 aspect ratios. Aug 13, 2026 Paid Plans Grok Imagine 1.5 Video xAI's Grok Imagine 1.5 is now available in Runway MCP as grok-imagine-1.5, supporting text-to-video and image-to-video from any MCP client. Generate 1-15 second clips with native audio, up to 1080p resolution. Aug 11, 2026 Enterprise Projects + Brand Kits in Agent Agent sessions now live inside Projects, so you can start a session directly from a Project or move existing ones in. Your Project's assets and Brand Kits are instantly accessible from inside the session, so you never re-upload logos, product shots or style references. Aug 11, 2026 Paid Plans Seedance 2.5 Seedance 2.5 is now available in Runway MCP. Generate up to 30 seconds of video with native audio, using text-to-video, image-to-video, or video-to-video, with first frame, last frame, and reference image controls, all directly from your AI agent. Aug 10, 2026 Pro+ Plans ProRes / PNG Sequence Export Tool Mode and Edit Studio now let you export Gen-4.5 and Aleph 2 generations as ProRes 4444 with PCM audio or a PNG sequence, instead of a compressed MP4. Drop your output straight onto a Resolve or Premiere timeline for a true editorial-grade workflow. Aug 7, 2026 Enterprise Comments on Assets Leave feedback directly on an image or video with the new Comments tab. Pin comments to an exact spot or moment in a video, and @-mention teammates to notify them by email. Aug 5, 2026 API MiniMax Hailuo 3.0 MiniMax Hailuo 3.0 is now live on Runway Dev. Generate video from text, image, or video, with support for keyframes plus reference images, videos, and audio. Aug 3, 2026 Paid Plans Model Router Routing History Every live routed request is now recorded, so you can see which model your Model Router picked and why. View it in the Activity tab of the dev portal or fetch the same records via the public API, and click any row for the full pipeline breakdown. Jul 30, 2026 API Eleven v3 ElevenLabs v3 is now available on Runway Dev. Generate expressive text-to-speech with inline audio tags like [laughs] and [whispers] via POST /v1/text_to_speech. Jul 30, 2026 API Task Cost API API responses now include the credit cost of each task, both while running as an estimate and on completion as the final cost. This makes it easy for platforms to meter and display per-generation pricing to their own users. Jul 30, 2026 API Capacity Fallbacks in Model Router When you hit your concurrency limit on a model, Model Router can now automatically fall back to the next-best eligible model with capacity instead of queuing your request. Opt in per model router in the dev portal to scale past your per-model concurrency limits without added latency. Jul 28, 2026 Paid Plans SAM3 Video Segmentation Pass in any video with a text prompt describing an entity to cut it out as a transparent webm video. You can also invert your selection to remove the background instead. Jul 23, 2026 All Plans Agent Workflows Agent can now build and run entire Workflows for you. Just describe what you want in plain language, and it assembles the full multi-step pipeline, nodes, inputs and all, which you can still inspect and edit yourself. Jul 22, 2026 Paid Plans Seedance 2.0 4K Runway MCP now supports Seedance 2.0 video generation in 4K resolution. Just explicitly request 4K to generate at the higher resolution. Jul 21, 2026 API Model Routers Configure allow/deny lists, cost caps, and optimization preferences for cost, latency, or quality, and Runway Dev will automatically select the best video model for each generation request. Build your integration once and stay on the best model as new ones are released, without manual updates. Jul 21, 2026 Paid Plans Seedance 2.0 Mini and Fast Two new lightweight Seedance 2.0 tiers are now available through Runway MCP. Seedance 2.0 Fast delivers quick 480p/720p turnaround with full text-to-video, image-to-video, audio, and keyframe support, while Seedance 2.0 Mini offers the cheapest and fastest option for rapid iteration, free in explore mode. Jul 21, 2026 Paid Plans Nano Banana 2 Lite Nano Banana 2 Lite is now available through Runway MCP. It's the fastest and most affordable Nano Banana model, ideal for quick iteration and experimentation at scale, at 4 credits per image and free in explore mode. Jul 20, 2026 Paid Plans Nano Banana 2 Nano Banana 2 is now available in Runway MCP. Generate images at 1K, 2K or 4K resolution for 7 credits per image, a more affordable option for experimentation. Jul 15, 2026 Paid Plans Seedream 5.0 Seedream 5.0 is now available as an image model in tool mode. Use up to 14 reference images and generate at 2K or 3K resolution across eight aspect ratios. Jul 14, 2026 API Aleph 2.0 in MCP Aleph 2.0 is now available through the Runway MCP. Ask your agent to edit videos, such as adding new elements to the background, using the new Edit Video tool. Jul 13, 2026 API Seedream 5.0 Lite Seedream 5.0 Lite is now available on Runway Dev. Generate images at 4 credits per image using the same text-to-image endpoint as Seedream 5.0 Pro. Jul 10, 2026 Paid Plans Nano Banana 2 Lite Nano Banana 2 Lite is now available in Tool Mode on mobile, with support for up to 14 reference images and fast image generation. Jul 9, 2026 All Plans Timeline in Agent Studio's timeline editor now lives inside Agent, so you can generate, assemble, refine and export a video in a single conversation. Ask the agent to sync clips to a track or assemble a multi-shot scene, or build and edit the timeline by hand. Jul 8, 2026 All Plans Custom Agent Skills Agent can now build custom Skills for you. Ask it to create one from scratch or turn an existing conversation into a reusable Skill you can share with your workspace. Jul 6, 2026 All Plans PDF Input for Agent Agent can now read PDFs you upload, pulling their content directly into generation. Drop in a brief, script or style guide up to 10MB and skip the copy-pasting. Jul 2, 2026 All Plans Runway Agent Skills Introducing Agent Skills. Build an ad campaign, create a commercial, localize your ads and more with a simple command. Jul 1, 2026 Paid Plans Nano Banana 2 Lite Nano Banana 2 Lite is now available in Runway. Create images at warp speed, without compromising on quality. Jun 30, 2026 Paid plans Gemini Omni Flash Generate and edit video with Gemini Omni Flash, now in Runway. Start with a prompt, an image or video and create anything you can imagine. Jun 29, 2026 Paid plans Seed Audio 1.0 Generate up to 120 seconds of dynamic speech, sound design and music with simple text prompts. Jun 25, 2026 All Plans Agent 2.0 Make marketing that drives revenue. Runway Agent creates entire campaigns, analyzes data to improve your creative and scales your marketing across platforms, formats and markets. Jun 18, 2026 All Plans Studio Trim, stitch, reorder and export a final video. All in one place. May 21, 2026 Paid Plans Aleph 2.0 & Edit Studio Get the video you need from the video you already have. Edit a frame the way you want, and Aleph 2.0 — our upgraded video editing model, now in Edit Studio — edits the rest of your video to match. May 13, 2026 All Plans Runway Agent Work with an AI creative partner to develop and produce a finished video. Describe the video you need, refine the direction together and generate it all in one conversation. Apr 7, 2026 Paid Plans Seedance 2.0 Use anything—text, image, video or audio—to generate or edit videos with Seedance 2.0. Now available on Unlimited and Enterprise plans outside the US. Mar 9, 2026 All Plans Runway Characters Introducing Runway Characters. Real-time intelligent avatars you can talk with and learn from. Now available via the Runway API and demo on web. Feb 27, 2026 Paid Plans Nano Banana 2 The most advanced and consistent image generation and editing model. Now available in Runway. Feb 20, 2026 Paid Plans New third party models All of the world’s best models, are now all available right inside of Runway. Including Kling 3.0, Kling 2.6 Pro, Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro, WAN2.2 Animate, GPT-Image-1.5, Sora 2 Pro and many more. More models coming soon. Jan 21, 2026 Paid Plans Gen-4.5 Image to Video You can now supply a first frame image alongside your text prompt with Gen-4.5. Dec 18, 2025 All Plans New Audio Features Text to Speech is now available via the Audio tab in Tool mode alongside new audio Apps for SFX and Speech to Speech. Dec 11, 2025 Paid Plans Gen-4.5 Introducing Gen-4.5, the world's best video model. Now available for all paid plans. Dec 4, 2025 Paid Plans Publish Workflows as Apps Turn your Workflows into Apps you can share with your workspace. Nov 21, 2025 Paid Plans Workflows Updates Audio nodes, video upscaling nodes and three new featured Workflows available now. Oct 24, 2025 Paid Plans Workflows Create your own custom node-based workflows chaining together multiple models, modalities and intermediary steps for even more control of your generations. Available now. Oct 14, 2025 Paid Plans Apps Apps are an ever-growing collection of use case specific workflows that make it easier than ever to get to great outputs. Apps are available now for web, with more releasing every week. Sep 11, 2025 All Plans Light Mode Light Mode now available in your settings. Update your theme from system settings to Light or Dark Mode for a personalized app experience. Aug 21, 2025 All Plans Game Worlds Beta Explore endless text-based worlds, characters and stories. All generated in real-time as you play. Aug 20, 2025 Paid Plans Voices Change the voice of your performances directly from within the Act-Two interface, giving you more creative flexibility when generating character performances. Aug 19, 2025 All Plans More Ways to Create Added support for select third party models within Chat Mode, and Gen-4 Image Turbo, is now available to all users. Jul 31, 2025 Paid Plans Aleph Aleph is now available for all paid plans. A new way to edit, transform and generate video. Jul 17, 2025 Paid Plans Act-Two Next-generation motion capture model with major improvements in generation quality and support for head, face, body and hand tracking. Jun 25, 2025 All Plans Gen-4 References: Improved Object Consistency An updated version of Gen-4 References that significantly improves object consistency and prompt adherence. Available for all users. Jun 12, 2025 All Plans Chat Mode A new way to create with Gen-4 Images, Videos and References. Generate anything you want, all from within a single conversational interface. Available for all users. May 29, 2025 All Plans Layout Sketch for Gen-4 References Start from a blank canvas or draw on top of an existing image to add new elements and compositions. Available now for all plans. May 16, 2025 API Gen-4 Image in Runway API Gen-4 Image is now available via the Runway API, allowing anyone to integrate its powerful multimodal generation capabilities directly into their apps, products, platforms and websites. May 7, 2025 All Plans Gen-4 Images and References for Free Plan Gen-4 Text to Image and References are now available to Free Plan users. Apr 30, 2025 Paid Plans Gen-4 References Generate consistent characters, locations and more. Now available for paid plans. Apr 7, 2025 All Plans Gen-4 Turbo Our fastest and most efficient video model. Now available to all users. Apr 1, 2025 Paid Plans Gen-4 is now available A new way to generate fast, controllable and production-ready media. Mar 6, 2025 All Plans Restyle Video You can now use a single reference image in Gen-3 Alpha and Turbo to style your Video to Video generations. Feb 22, 2025 Paid Plans New Frames features You can now turn reference images into text prompts and Custom Styles inside Frames. Jan 17, 2025 Paid Plans Frames Our most advanced base model for image generation, offering unprecedented stylistic control and visual fidelity. Now available for Unlimited and Enterprise plans. Jan 10, 2025 Paid Plans Upscale video generations You can now upscale to 4K directly inside Gen-3 Alpha. Making it easer than ever to generate production-ready outputs, all in one place. Jan 9, 2025 All Plans Asset Tags Keep track of assets through complex workflows using tags. Dec 19, 2024 All Plans Middle keyframes in Gen-3 Alpha Turbo Add a middle keyframe in addition to first and last keyframes, for more control over your image to video generations. Support for First, Last, and First/Last Keyframes, a new self-serve, no commitment usage tier with a higher max concurrency limit, and added support for multi-user organizations allowing you to invite additional users to help manage keys, billing and usage metrics. Nov 9, 2024 Paid Plans Vertical videos in Act-One Generate vertical videos using Act-One with Gen-3 Alpha. Nov 1, 2024 All Plans Camera Control in Gen-3 Alpha Turbo Advanced Camera Control is now available for Gen-3 Alpha Turbo. Choose both the direction and intensity of how you move through your scenes for even more intention in every shot. Oct 25, 2024 Paid Plans Act-One in Gen-3 Alpha Introducing, Act-One. A new way to generate expressive character performances inside Gen-3 Alpha using a single driving video and character image. No motion capture or rigging required. Act-One is gradually rolling out to users and will soon be available to everyone. Oct 24, 2024 All Plans Generative Video GIF exports Export your video generations as GIFs from the Gen-2, Gen-3 Alpha and Gen-3 Alpha Turbo generation feeds. Oct 8, 2024 All Plans Keyframes in Gen-3 Alpha Turbo Provide both first and last frame inputs for Gen-3 Alpha Turbo. Available for all users on web in both horizontal and vertical aspect ratios. Sep 26, 2024 All Plans Video to Video in Gen-3 Alpha Turbo Iterate faster than ever before with Video to Video in Gen-3 Alpha Turbo. Sep 23, 2024 All Plans Gen-3 Alpha Turbo Extensions Extend generations up to 34s in Gen-3 Alpha Turbo. Sep 20, 2024 All Plans Vertical videos in Gen-3 Alpha Turbo Vertical video generations are now available to all users with Gen-3 Alpha Turbo. Sep 20, 2024 Enterprise Credit Analytics Workspace Analytics now contains graphs that provide an overview of credit usage across the workspace. Sep 16, 2024 API Runway API Use our simple-to-integrate API to access our latest and most powerful video models inside a safe and reliable environment. Sep 13, 2024 Paid Plans Video to Video in Gen-3 Alpha Video to Video represents a new control mechanism for precise movement, expressiveness and intent within generations. To use Video to Video, simply upload your input video, prompt in any aesthetic direction you like, or, choose from a collection of preset styles.
